candidates.angle: Einride is the only top-tier AV trucking player betting on no-cab all-electric. Ohio is the first Midwest deployment. The interesting question for carriers and 3PLs: is a state-DOT-backed corridor with a small regional 3PL a more realistic adoption path than the Aurora hub-to-hub model, and what does that imply for warehouse yard design when there is literally no cab to dock?
